description: Several listing photos at once: one plan of photo steps (straighten, enhance, sky, lawn, staging, declutter…) with one total and one confirmation, instead of a confirm per photo. The first call runs nothing: it returns each step's cost, the total and a confirmationCode, and the Pixly card shows the plan with one button. After the user says yes in the chat, call again with only confirmationCode: it starts every step whose photo is ready and returns their jobs (poll with get_job jobIds). Steps that work on an earlier step's result start when you call again with the same confirmationCode once that result is completed. Only for photos; videos have their own tools.

confirmationCode.description: The plan's confirmationCode — only after the user agreed to the plan. Starts the steps whose photo is ready; call again with it later to start steps that work on earlier results.

listingId.description: A property folder (from list_listings or create_listing) to put the result in. Results of a photo that is already in a folder go there by themselves.

photos.description: Every photo of the set, in order; steps refer to them by number (from 1)

r2Path.description: A Pixly storage path (a resultPaths entry)

steps.description: What to do, step by step

after.description: Instead of photo: the index (from 0) of an earlier step whose result this step works on

options.description: The tool's own options, only what the user asked for (e.g. {"style": "scandinavian"})

photo.description: Which photo this step works on (from 1)

name: plan_photos

jobs.description: Several jobs at once (get_job with jobIds, or a plan's steps): each one's jobId, status and results

quote.description: Present when status is "awaiting_confirmation": nothing ran and nothing was charged yet — the price and settings the user is asked to confirm

resultPaths.description: Storage path of each result — pass one as r2Path (or beforeR2Path, a photos[] item) to run another tool on this result

status.description: pending | processing | completed | failed — anything not completed/failed is still running

title: Plan Photo Edits
